claims.claim: Knight disclosed a technology issue at the NYSE open on August 1, 2012.
Knight attributed erroneous orders to software installation in the August 2 statement.
Knight reported about USD 440 million realized pre-tax loss on August 2.
The SEC later found code had not been copied to one of eight SMARS servers.
The SEC later found that 212 parent orders were processed by defective code.
The SEC later disclosed 97 internal automated emails associated with failure.
claims.locator: SEC press release 2013-222, discussion of automated emails

claims.claim: The SEC order found violation of Rule 15c3-5 market-access controls.

rule: A claim is eligible at a cutoff only if its cited document was published by that date; event dates do not establish public availability.
